register.notes: No state packaging register — RENAP covers only WEEE/batteries/tyres. CONAI (private-law consortium) membership is the compliance mechanism and issues the producer position used in practice.

pro.ecoModulation: CAC is banded by recyclability: plastic bands A1.1 0.040 → C 0.790 €/kg; paper composites 0.045 (mono) → 0.285 (type D) €/kg; compostable bioplastics 0.130 €/kg.

notes: Rates are the CONAI contributo ambientale (CAC) from 01.01.2026, fetched from conai.org 2026-08-16, converted €/t → €/kg: steel 0.005, aluminium 0.012 ('metal' shows aluminium), paper mono-material 0.045, wood 0.010, glass 0.040, paper-based beverage cartons (CPL) 0.115 ('composite'), plastic bands 0.040–0.790 ('plastic' shows common household band B1.1 0.219). CAC is far lower than northern-EU PRO fees because Italian municipal collection is financed separately. Material consortia under CONAI: COREPLA (plastic), COMIECO (paper), RICREA (steel), CIAL (aluminium), COREVE (glass), RILEGNO (wood). One-off CONAI membership quota applies (based on turnover) — not in the rate table.
